uni-head.title: University
uni-head.body: Chapters in the order you use QuantGPT. Each is a lesson of 3 minutes or less, one thing to do in the product and a three-question check. Your progress is saved on your account.

steps.title: The three steps
steps.body: The chapters in the order you use QuantGPT. Chapters marked QuantGPT open on every plan, those marked QuantGPT Pro on QuantGPT Pro and Business. A chapter with a lock still shows what it covers.

more.title: Every lesson on one shelf
more.body: The Learn page lists the playable lessons under the same three steps. Every one of them plays without signing in; here, signed in, each chapter adds a thing to do and a check.
